q_earPainRash.help:
Pain or blisters around the ear.

q_speechType.ask: What is wrong with the speech?
q_speechType.help:
How the speech sounds.
Slurred, wrong words or no words point to different causes.

q_weakWhere.help:
The part of the body that is weak.
The place helps the doctor find the cause.

q_numbWhere.help:
The part of the body that is numb.
The place helps the doctor find the cause.

q_hd_dur.ask: How long did the numbness last?
q_hd_dur.help:
How many minutes or hours it lasted.
Short spells that clear can be a warning.

q_hd_side.help:
Left or right side of the body.
One side points to the brain.

q_tinglingWhere.help:
The part of the body that tingles.
The place helps the doctor find the cause.

q_lowB12Diet.ask: Are you vegetarian, or on metformin for years?
q_lowB12Diet.help:
A diet or medicine that can lower vitamin B12.
Low B12 can cause tingling.

q_hd_tside.help:
Left or right side of the body.
One side points to the brain.

q_memoryCourse.help:
Sudden, slow, or on and off.
Sudden loss is an emergency; slow loss needs a check.

q_repeatsQuestions.ask: Do you repeat the same question or story?
q_repeatsQuestions.help:
Asking again and again within minutes.
It is a common early sign.

q_gotLost.ask: Have you got lost somewhere you know well?
q_gotLost.help:
Losing the way in a familiar place.
It is a common early sign.

q_dailyTasksHarder.ask: Is it harder to manage money, meals or medicines?
q_dailyTasksHarder.help:
Everyday jobs that were easy are now hard.
It shows how much memory affects life.

q_moodLow.ask: Do you feel low or lose interest in things?
q_moodLow.help:
Sad most days.
Low mood can look like forgetting.

q_tremorWhen.ask: When do the hands shake most?
q_tremorWhen.help:
At rest, or when using the hands.
Rest shaking and action shaking have different causes.

q_slowStiff.ask: Are you slower, stiffer, or taking smaller steps?
q_slowStiff.help:
Slow movement or stiff limbs.
It can go with Parkinson disease.

q_heartRacingSweat.ask: Is your heart racing, or are you sweating or losing weight?
q_heartRacingSweat.help:
Fast heart, sweats, thinner.
An overactive thyroid can cause shaking.

q_alcoholCut.ask: Do you drink daily and recently cut down?
q_alcoholCut.help:
Heavy drinking, then stopping.
Stopping can cause shaking and fits.

q_feetNumb.ask: Are your feet numb or tingling?
q_feetNumb.help:
Loss of feeling in the feet.
Numb feet make walking unsteady.

q_headacheWithBalance.ask: Is there a new bad headache, or vomiting, with it?
q_headacheWithBalance.help:
A fresh headache or being sick.
Problems at the back of the brain can cause both.

q_fellRecently.ask: Have you fallen in the past month?
q_fellRecently.help:
Any fall, even without injury.
Falls show a higher risk of a bad fall.

q_earDischargeColour.ask: What does the fluid look like?
q_earDischargeColour.help:
The look of the fluid from the ear.
Blood or clear fluid needs care.

q_swollenBehindEar.ask: Is the skin behind the ear red, swollen or sore?
q_swollenBehindEar.help:
Puffy, red or tender skin behind the ear.
The infection may have spread to the bone.

q_hasRinging.ask: Is there ringing or buzzing in that ear?
q_hasRinging.help:
Noise in the ear with no outside sound.
Ringing with hearing loss needs a check.

q_pulseTinnitus.ask: Does the noise beat with your heartbeat?
q_pulseTinnitus.help:
A whooshing that matches your pulse.
It can come from a blood vessel.

q_tinnitusDistress.ask: Is the noise upsetting your sleep or mood?
q_tinnitusDistress.help:
The noise is hard to bear.
Distress can be treated.

q_earBlocked.ask: Does the ear feel blocked or full?
q_earBlocked.help:
A plugged feeling.
Wax or fluid can cause this.

q_lowImmune.ask: Are you on chemo, steroids, or medicine that lowers immunity?
q_lowImmune.help:
Treatment that weakens the body's defence.
Infections can turn serious fast.

q_bloodInSpit.ask: Is there blood in your spit?
q_bloodInSpit.help:
Streaks or spots of blood.
Blood needs a cause found.

q_lostWeight.ask: Have you lost weight without trying?
q_lostWeight.help:
Clothes are looser, no diet.
It can go with serious illness.

q_afterColdOrShouting.ask: Did it start after a cold or shouting?
q_afterColdOrShouting.help:
A clear trigger like a cold.
A clear cause and quick recovery is reassuring.

q_doubleWorse.ask: Did you get a bit better, then worse again?
q_doubleWorse.help:
A second dip after first easing.
A second dip can mean a bacterial infection.

q_sprayOverWeek.ask: Have you used nose spray for more than a week?
q_sprayOverWeek.help:
Decongestant spray most days.
Long use makes the nose block worse.

q_afterNoseKnock.ask: Did it start after a knock to the nose?
q_afterNoseKnock.help:
A blow to the nose.
A blood bump in the nose needs same-day care.

q_afterNewTrigger.ask: Did it start after a food, sting or medicine?
q_afterNewTrigger.help:
A new thing eaten, stung or taken.
An allergy can turn serious fast.

q_sneezeTrigger.ask: What seems to set it off?
q_sneezeTrigger.help:
The thing that brings on sneezing.
A clear trigger points to allergy.

q_smellOrTaste.ask: Have you lost smell, taste or both?
q_smellOrTaste.help:
Which sense is affected.
It helps the doctor narrow the cause.

q_noseBlockedNow.ask: Is your nose blocked or runny?
q_noseBlockedNow.help:
A cold or block in the nose.
A blocked nose explains lost smell.

q_appetiteLow.ask: Are you eating much less because of it?
q_appetiteLow.help:
Food has lost its appeal.
Poor eating can cause weight loss.

q_re_halos.ask: Do you see rainbow rings round lights?
q_re_halos.help:
Coloured rings around bright lights.
It can mean high pressure inside the eye.

q_re_light.ask: Does bright light hurt the eye?
q_re_light.help:
Light makes the eye sore.
It can mean the front of the eye is inflamed.

q_re_gunk.ask: Is there sticky yellow or green gunk?
q_re_gunk.help:
Thick gunk that glues the lids.
It helps tell an infection from allergy.

q_lumpInnerCorner.ask: Is there a red, sore lump by the corner of the eye?
q_lumpInnerCorner.help:
A tender swelling beside the nose.
The tear sac may be infected.

q_cannotCloseEye.ask: Can you not close the eye fully?
q_cannotCloseEye.help:
The lid will not shut.
The eye dries and can be damaged.

q_thirstPee.ask: Are you very thirsty, passing lots of urine?
q_thirstPee.help:
Drinking and peeing far more than usual.
High sugar can blur sight.

q_doubleGoesOneClosed.ask: Does it go away if you close one eye?
q_doubleGoesOneClosed.help:
Seeing two goes to one with an eye shut.
Double sight from both eyes can be a nerve or brain cause.

q_eyelidDroop.ask: Is an eyelid drooping, or is one pupil bigger?
q_eyelidDroop.help:
A lid that sags, or unequal pupils.
A nerve may be pressed, or a blood vessel bulging.

q_worseEvening.ask: Is it worse when tired or late in the day?
q_worseEvening.help:
It gets worse through the day.
It can go with a muscle-nerve illness.

q_dryMouthToo.help:
Dry eyes and a dry mouth together.
It can go with a dryness illness.

q_shortSighted.ask: Are you very short-sighted, or had eye surgery?
q_shortSighted.help:
Strong glasses or past eye operation.
These raise the risk of a loose retina.

q_manyFloaters.ask: Did a shower of new dark spots appear?
q_manyFloaters.help:
Many new specks at once.
It can mean the retina is tearing.

q_toothChest.ask: Does it come with effort, chest tightness or sweating?
q_toothChest.help:
Tooth or jaw pain with exertion or chest symptoms.
Heart pain can spread to the jaw and teeth.

q_faceSwollen.ask: Is your face or jaw swollen?
q_faceSwollen.help:
Swelling of the cheek or jaw.
A tooth infection can spread.

q_painWakes.ask: Does it wake you, or linger after hot or cold?
q_painWakes.help:
Pain at night or lasting after a drink.
It shows deep tooth damage.

q_bleedOnlyBrushing.ask: Do gums bleed only when you brush?
q_bleedOnlyBrushing.help:
Bleeding only when cleaning.
This is usually gum inflammation.

q_bleedSpont.ask: Do gums bleed on their own, without brushing?
q_bleedSpont.help:
Bleeding with no touch.
Bleeding on its own can mean a blood problem.

q_tiredPale.ask: Are you very tired or pale lately?
q_tiredPale.help:
More tired or pale than usual.
It can go with a blood problem.

q_gumPus.ask: Is a gum swollen, painful or oozing pus?
q_gumPus.help:
A sore lump on the gum.
It can be a tooth abscess.

q_ulcerNumber.ask: How many ulcers do you have?
q_ulcerNumber.help:
A count of sores in the mouth.
Many ulcers point to a different cause.

q_ulcerHard.ask: Is it hard, or a red or white patch that stays?
q_ulcerHard.help:
A firm lump or a patch that stays.
These can be early mouth cancer.

q_painStopsDrinking.ask: Is it too sore to eat or drink?
q_painStopsDrinking.help:
Pain stops you taking fluids.
Being dry is risky, more so when older.

q_dentureLoose.ask: Do your dentures rock or rub?
q_dentureLoose.help:
Dentures that move or rub the gum.
Rubbing makes sores.

q_sorePatch.ask: Is there a red or raw patch on the gum?
q_sorePatch.help:
A sore spot under the denture.
It helps find where they rub.

q_whitePatch.ask: Are there white patches that wipe off?
q_whitePatch.help:
Creamy patches on gum or tongue.
It can be thrush.

q_wearAtNight.ask: Do you sleep with dentures in?
q_wearAtNight.help:
Wearing dentures overnight.
It raises the chance of sores and thrush.

q_veryThirsty.ask: Are you very thirsty, or peeing much more?
q_veryThirsty.help:
Thirst or passing lots of urine.
High sugar dries the mouth.

q_drowsy.ask: Are you unusually sleepy or muddled?
q_drowsy.help:
More sleepy or confused than normal.
Being very dry can do this.

q_cheekSwollen.ask: Is a cheek or under the jaw swollen and sore?
q_cheekSwollen.help:
Swelling near the ear or jaw.
A spit gland may be blocked or infected.
